senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; חָנָה)camp, esp. the encampment of the Israelites in the desert (v.
units: Num. II); transferred to the limits of graded sacredness in Jerusalem (v. מְחִיצָה II).

<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 1:7">Sifré Num. 1</cite> <he>מַחְנֵה ישראל</he> the camp of the Israelites (from the gate of Jerusalem to the Temple mount); <he>מ׳ לויה</he> the camp of the attendants (priests and Levites, from the Temple mount to the Temple court); <he>מ׳ שכינה</he> the camp of the Divine Majesty (from the entrance of the court and further).

<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 1:7">Ib.</cite> <he>מ׳ ארון</he> the camp of the Ark in the desert (= <he>מ׳ לויה</he>); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 8:3:1">Y. Sot. VIII, 22ᵇ</cite> bot.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מַחֲנוֹת</he>. Sifré l. c. <he>שלש מ׳ הן</he> there are three camps of graded sacredness (= <he>מְחִיצוֹת</he>).
